homepage.title: Do You Show Dementia Signs?
homepage.summary: Ten quick personal memory and thinking questions. See how your answers stack up.

footer.aboutText: This quiz is for general knowledge, entertainment, and self-reflection only. It is not a dementia screening tool, medical advice, diagnosis, cognitive assessment, or clinical test. Dementia symptoms can have many causes, and only a qualified healthcare professional can assess real concerns. If you are worried about memory, thinking, mood, communication, or daily functioning changes in yourself or someone else, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

questions.prompt: How often do you forget something someone told you recently?
choices: Rarely, or I remember after a moment
Sometimes, especially when I am busy
Often enough that it bothers me
Very often, and it affects my day
questions.explanation: Frequent memory changes that affect daily life are more worth discussing than occasional slips.

questions.prompt: How often do familiar everyday tasks suddenly feel confusing?
choices: Rarely
Only with new or complicated tasks
Sometimes with familiar tasks
Often with tasks I used to do easily
questions.explanation: New or repeated difficulty with familiar tasks can be more important than finding new tasks hard.

questions.prompt: How often do you struggle to find a common word while talking?
choices: Rarely, or the word comes back quickly
Sometimes when tired or distracted
Often enough that conversations feel harder
Very often, and I lose track of what I was saying
questions.explanation: Occasional word-finding is common; frequent trouble following conversation can be more important.

questions.prompt: How often do you feel unsure about the day, place, or route in familiar situations?
choices: Rarely
Only briefly, then I orient myself
Sometimes in places I know well
Often enough that I need help
questions.explanation: Repeated confusion about time, place, or familiar routes can be more meaningful than a brief lapse.

questions.prompt: How often do bills, recipes, forms, or simple plans feel harder than they used to?
choices: Rarely
Only when the task is new or stressful
Sometimes with tasks that used to feel easy
Often enough that I avoid them
questions.explanation: New difficulty with familiar planning tasks can be worth paying attention to.

questions.prompt: How often do you put things in odd places and struggle to retrace your steps?
choices: Rarely
Sometimes, but I usually retrace my steps
Often enough that it causes problems
Very often, and I cannot work out what happened
questions.explanation: Misplacing things happens to many people, but unusual patterns plus difficulty retracing steps can matter more.
The pattern doubles each time, so 16 becomes 32.

questions.prompt: Basic visual thinking: if you turn right from facing north, which direction are you facing?
choices: East
South
West
North
questions.explanation: A right turn from north points east.

questions.prompt: Quick recall: remember this pair for the next question: River = 42. What number is paired with River?
Quick logic: if all zibs are naks, and some naks are blue, what must be true?
choices: All zibs are blue
Some zibs are definitely blue
All zibs are naks
No naks are blue
questions.explanation: The only statement guaranteed by the first rule is that all zibs are naks.
